faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BDKAB Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Accountant post at Bilasa Devi Kevat Airport Bilaspur is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com degree with ICWA/CA/MBA (full-time regular, two years duration) specializing in finance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23,350.00.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Accountant position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Bilasa Devi Kevat Airport Bilaspur (BDKAB).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the airport located?
faq.answer: Bilasa Devi Kevat Airport is located in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, with a pincode of 495220.
